author: Epic Games
description:
The hurricane subsides, but in its wake, a litany of new threats to overcome. Speranza is buzzing with rumors and half-truths, with speculation of a new ARC operation, evolving enemy threats, and unknown aerial phenomena. Tian Wen is furiously working on new combat tech while Shani and Celeste attempt to get an eye in the sky. What they find is anyone’s guess.

Purchase ARC Raiders now! https://epic.gm/arc-raiders
title: ARC Raiders | Flashpoint Update Trailer
